name: BCF Issue Exchange
description: Write issues (for example QA/QC findings) to a BCF 2.1 .bcfzip file and read a .bcfzip back into a plain issue list. Also list, create and update topics on a BCF 3.0 REST server (credentials from the environment; create and update need an approved plan). Never changes the Revit model. UNVERIFIED for interop with other BCF tools and real BCF servers.
author: AEC Model Bridge

output_path.description: Where to save the .bcfzip file. Must end in .bcfzip and be inside the allowed workspace directories. A relative path is placed in the workspace folder.

issues.description: Issues to export. Each issue may have title, description, status, priority, element_uids (Revit UniqueIds), ifc_guids, author and assigned_to.

use_qaqc_issues.description: Also export the issues recorded by the QA/QC checker for this workspace.

project_name.description: Optional project name stored in the file.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists.

bcf_path.description: The .bcfzip file to read. Must be inside the allowed workspace directories.

commands.title: List Topics on a BCF 3.0 Server (read-only, credentials from the environment)

project_id.description: BCF server project id. Defaults to the MCP_REVIT_BCF_PROJECT_ID environment variable.

commands.title: Create a Topic on a BCF 3.0 Server (needs an approved plan, credentials from the environment)

project_id.description: BCF server project id. Defaults to the MCP_REVIT_BCF_PROJECT_ID environment variable.

topic_type.description: Topic type, for example Issue or Clash.

topic_status.description: Topic status, for example Open or Closed.

assigned_to.description: User the topic is assigned to.

commands.title: Update a Topic on a BCF 3.0 Server (needs an approved plan, credentials from the environment)

project_id.description: BCF server project id. Defaults to the MCP_REVIT_BCF_PROJECT_ID environment variable.

topic_guid.description: GUID of the topic to update.

topic_type.description: Topic type, for example Issue or Clash.

topic_status.description: Topic status, for example Open or Closed.

assigned_to.description: User the topic is assigned to.
